title: Website Content Performance Meta-Analysis
methodology: Cross-referenced feed.json (452 articles) with Supabase analytics API (15 tracked views, 3 likes, 3 bookmarks)

data_overview.caveat: Very early stage — only 15 views tracked. Engagement data is directional, not statistically significant.

audience_performance.summary: member_qa has highest engagement density (2 views/article). Research content has most total engagement signals (2 likes, 1 bookmark). General content has views but zero engagement signals.
audience_performance.insight: Member Q&A articles are most 'sticky' — readers who find them are more likely to bookmark. Research content drives likes (social proof). General content is viewed but not acted on — possible quality or targeting gap.

top_articles.title: 【會員提問】升息環境要調整 50/50 配置嗎？數據說不用
2026 Q1 即時驗證：6 個策略全勝 SPY——VT 保險正在理賠
恐慌賣出讓你 20 年少賺 29 萬美元——兩個投資人的真實對決
253 個起始日，100% 勝率——VT 不是回測幻覺的最強證據

content_length_analysis.insight: 53.6% of articles are under 500 chars — essentially micro-posts. Top-performing articles average 1,700 chars. The 33 general-audience articles average 1,618 chars. Long-form content (1000+ chars) represents only 18.3% of articles but likely drives disproportionate value.
content_length_analysis.optimal_range: 1,000-3,000 chars appears to be the sweet spot: detailed enough to provide value, short enough to be read in 2-5 minutes

tag_analysis.insight: 行為金融 has only 2 articles but 88 weighted views — highest views-per-article. VT策略 and SPY are volume leaders but also the most saturated. 12/VIX content is efficient (110 weighted views from just 45 articles).

severely_oversaturated.problem: Highest count but below-average content length. Many short micro-posts that add little incremental value.
Combined 226 articles about GARCH variants. The core message (GJR is best) was established early. Diminishing returns on more GARCH articles.
Highly technical topic with many short posts. Few general readers would engage.
Research concept that proved to have no alpha (Conditional VT null per J13). Dead-end topic still overrepresented.

oversaturation_analysis.action: Stop producing more short articles on GARCH/VaR/Hybrid-VT. These topics are fully explored.

high_potential.topic: 行為金融 / 投資心理
high_potential.opportunity: Massively underserved. 2 articles but among highest engagement. Stories about investor behavior resonate strongly.
Long-form, high-quality content. Directly relevant to reader goals. Only 3 articles.

high_potential.topic: 實戰指南 / 投資教學
high_potential.opportunity: Practical how-to content is scarce. Readers want actionable guidance.
Only 21 articles vs 184 for SPY. Taiwan readers are a primary audience but underserved.
Highest engagement density. Real questions from real users create immediately relevant content.
Only 1 article tied to current events (private credit). Timely analysis drives urgency and shares.
Core retail investing strategy. Only 4 articles.

underserved_topics.action: Prioritize content in these areas. Each article in these categories will have higher marginal impact than another GARCH explainer.

title_patterns.insight: Em-dash titles (Statement——Dramatic conclusion) appear in 3/5 top articles but only 12% of all articles. Question-mark titles appear in 1/5 top articles but only 8% of all articles. These high-engagement patterns are underused.
title_patterns.recommended_formula: Concrete number + em-dash + reader-relevant claim. E.g., '每月花 5 分鐘——懶人版波動率擇時實戰'

posting_cadence.problem: Extremely burst-heavy publishing. 131 articles in one day is content flooding — readers cannot digest this. The most recent days (Mar 19-20) had 1 article each, which is far more sustainable.
posting_cadence.recommendation: Target 2-5 articles per day maximum. Prioritize quality over quantity. Use the article pool/scheduling system to spread content evenly.

write_more.topic: 行為金融 / 投資心理 / 恐慌賣出
write_more.why: Highest engagement-per-article (88 weighted views from 2 articles). Narrative-driven content that non-researchers can connect with.
write_more.format: Long-form stories (2000-3000 chars), em-dash titles, specific dollar amounts

write_more.why: 2x views per article. Readers seek answers to their specific questions. Creates community.
write_more.format: 1500-2500 chars, 【會員提問】bracket label, answer with data

write_more.why: Primary audience is Taiwanese investors. Only 21 articles (vs 184 SPY). Direct relevance.
write_more.format: Practical guides with Taiwan-specific context (tax, ETF, rebalancing schedule)

write_more.topic: 退休 / 長期投資 / DCA
write_more.why: Connects research to life goals. High avg content length (3000+ chars) suggests quality bar is already high.
write_more.format: Scenario-based, Monte Carlo results in plain language

write_more.topic: 市場時事 + 我們的模型怎麼看
write_more.why: Only 1 article. Timely content creates urgency. Demonstrates system is alive and responsive.
write_more.format: What happened + What VT says + What to do (or not do)

write_less.why: Core finding (GJR is best) established long ago. Technical GARCH articles have below-average engagement and content length. Audience for pure GARCH content is near-zero retail readers.
Highly specialized. 540 avg chars suggests many micro-posts. Consolidate into 1-2 definitive guides instead.
Research concluded these don't work (J13: all null). Publishing more articles on a dead-end erodes credibility.
Academic concept. Relevant for the paper, not for feed content.

format_improvements: Increase median article length from 488 to 1000+ chars. Articles under 300 chars should be combined or dropped.
Use em-dash titles more often (currently 12%, should be 30-40% for non-daily content).
Add question-style titles for general audience content (currently 8%, target 20%).
Spread publishing across days (max 5/day) instead of burst publishing (131/day observed).
Every article should have a clear 'So what?' for the reader in the first paragraph.

content_strategy_shift.from: Research log → publish everything as milestone → content flood
content_strategy_shift.to: Curated content calendar → 2-3 high-quality articles per day → mix of research + practical + Q&A

key_findings_summary: 1. CONTENT FLOODING is the #1 problem: 452 articles in 8 days (56.5/day avg) overwhelms readers. Quality >> quantity.
2. BEHAVIORAL FINANCE is the highest-ROI content category: 2 articles drove 88 weighted views. Stories > statistics for engagement.
3. MEMBER Q&A has 2x engagement density: real questions = real relevance. Should be a content pillar.
4. GENERAL audience content gets views but ZERO engagement: the content is being seen but not resonating. Needs stronger hooks and calls to action.
5. RESEARCH content actually gets the most likes/bookmarks: readers who engage deeply value rigorous analysis. Don't abandon it — refine it.
6. GARCH/VaR/Hybrid-VT are oversaturated: 378 articles on topics with declining marginal value. Consolidate into definitive guides.
7. TAIWAN market content is underserved: only 21 articles for the primary audience geography.
8. OPTIMAL article length is 1000-3000 chars: long enough for substance, short enough to finish. Current median (488) is too short.
9. EM-DASH titles outperform: 3/5 top articles use this pattern but only 12% of all articles.
10. 93.3% of views come from members: SEO/discovery is essentially zero. Priority must be retention AND acquisition.
